speaker: therapist
text: Hi, good to see you. How are you getting on with the new prosthesis?

speaker: patient
text: Better. I wear it in the mornings and in the gym here. At home I still use the crutches mostly.

speaker: therapist
text: That's what we agreed for now. How is the skin at the end of the leg?

speaker: patient
text: It is okay. A little red after the gym, then it goes away.

speaker: therapist
text: Good, that sounds normal for this stage.

speaker: patient
text: One thing. Can I get the exercises written in Ukrainian? I understand English when we talk, but at home I forget the details.

speaker: therapist
text: Yes, you'll get the program in Ukrainian. Let's go through it.

speaker: therapist
text: First, lying on your stomach. It keeps the hip straight, which matters a lot when you sit so much.

speaker: therapist
text: Lie on your stomach for ten minutes, twice a day.

speaker: patient
text: On the bed is okay?

speaker: therapist
text: On the bed is fine.

speaker: therapist
text: Second, the bridge. Last time we did it with both legs, but for now do it only on the right leg.

speaker: therapist
text: Lie on your back, right knee bent, the left leg straight, and lift your hips. Three sets of ten, every day.

speaker: patient
text: Only the right.

speaker: therapist
text: Only the right for now.

speaker: therapist
text: Third, on your side. Lie on your right side and lift the left leg straight up, then lower it slowly.

speaker: therapist
text: Three sets of twelve, every day.

speaker: patient
text: That one is hard. The leg feels light and heavy at the same time.

speaker: therapist
text: That's normal at this stage. The muscles are learning again.

speaker: therapist
text: Fourth, the band. Sit on a chair with the band around the left leg just below the knee, and straighten the knee against it.

speaker: therapist
text: Three sets of twelve, every day, on the left.

speaker: patient
text: Okay.

speaker: therapist
text: And the last one. You've been standing on the prosthesis alone here in the gym, and it's going well.

speaker: patient
text: Yes, I can do almost a minute now.

speaker: therapist
text: So let's add it at home too. Stand on the left leg with the prosthesis on, three times thirty seconds, every day.

speaker: therapist
text: Stand next to the kitchen counter so you can grab it.

speaker: patient
text: At home, alone?

speaker: therapist
text: Yes. Next to the counter you can hold on if you need to.

speaker: patient
text: The prosthetist sees me again on Thursday, for the socket.

speaker: therapist
text: Good, tell them how the gym sessions have gone.

speaker: therapist
text: So that's five exercises: lying on your stomach, the bridge on the right, the side leg lift on the left, the band on the left, and standing on the prosthesis.

speaker: patient
text: Five. Good.

speaker: therapist
text: You're doing well. See you next week, same time.

speaker: patient
text: Thank you. See you next week.
